# Step 2: Build Gaussian Bayesian Network using Linear Regression
# For each node, fit a linear regression model with its parents
# Store the coefficients and residuals (for variance)

class GaussianBN:
    def __init__(self, edges):
        self.edges = edges
        self.parents = {}  # child -> list of parents
        self.models = {}   # child -> trained LinearRegression model
        self.intercepts = {}  # child -> intercept
        self.coefs = {}    # child -> coefficients
        self.residual_var = {}  # child -> variance of residuals
        
        # Initialize parents for each node
        for child, parent in edges:
            if child not in self.parents:
                self.parents[child] = []
            self.parents[child].append(parent)
        
        # Ensure all nodes have an entry in parents (even if empty)
        all_nodes = set()
        for child, parent in edges:
            all_nodes.add(child)
            all_nodes.add(parent)
        for node in all_nodes:
            if node not in self.parents:
                self.parents[node] = []
    
    def fit(self, df):
        """Fit the Gaussian BN using linear regression"""
        for child in self.parents:
            parent_nodes = self.parents[child]
            if len(parent_nodes) == 0:
                # No parents: set intercept to mean, variance to std^2
                self.intercepts[child] = df[child].mean()
                self.residual_var[child] = df[child].var()
                self.models[child] = None
